deepdive.sec: Luxury & Consumer Goods / Organized Gold Jewellery Retail & Manufacturing

bull_bear.body: Debt-equity ratio targeted at 1:1 to 1:1.5; no equity dilution planned; profits reinvested into retail expansion and inventory; GML (gold metal loan) being explored for new store funding
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Gold import duty hike and policy uncertainty; potential black market price arbitrage; consumer sentiment shift post PM's 'don't buy gold' remark; delayed store openings due to market volatility
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Optimistic on long-term growth, conservative on near-term guidance; confident in Gujarat white space; focused on execution, not speculation; transparent on inventory cushion but opaque on exact inventory gains
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: Job work revenue decline was due to gold price inflation reducing kg volume, not demand loss — value of merchandise in B2B rose to INR843cr; inventory gain estimated at INR10-12cr, implying normalized PAT of INR9-10cr; retail margins are 3-4% higher than wholesale despite higher opex; 50-55% capacity utilization is sustainable due to gold price inflation doubling revenue without adding artisans
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- Returns disclosed for FY26: ROE 20.12% and ROCE 29.10% (FY23: 27.45% / 37.89%; FY24: 14.40% / 21.49%; FY25: 17.15% / 25.81%); the snapshot slide rounds these to "ROCE: 29%" and "ROE: 20%".
- Net worth grew 925 → 2,075 → 2,450 → 2,998 INR Mn across FY23-FY26, with growth funded from retained earnings — Equity Share Capital unchanged at INR 400 Mn through FY24-FY26.
- Net D/E charted at 0.95x (FY23), 0.26x (FY24), 0.34x (FY25) and 0.46x (FY26); FY26 borrowings were INR 1,184 Mn current and INR 225 Mn non-current.
- Working capital is inventory-heavy: inventories INR 3,357 Mn in FY26 (FY25: 2,923; FY24: 2,242) against total assets of INR 4,860 Mn; trade receivables jumped to INR 558 Mn in FY26 from INR 173 Mn in FY25.
- Shareholding as on 30th June 2026: Promoters 75.00%, AIF 0.01%, Public 24.99%. The deck makes no mention of dividends or buybacks.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body: Retail: INR121cr (+31% YoY); Wholesale: INR67cr (+57% YoY); Job work: INR1cr; B2B total merchandise value: INR843cr; Retail: INR408cr FY26; total B2B+B2C merchandise: INR1,251cr FY26
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body:
- Founded in 2008 and led by the father-son duo Mr. Rajendrakumar and Mr. Harit Zaveri; described as "a leading organised gold jewellery manufacturer" with "30+ Years of rich legacy in Jewellery Industry".
- Wholesale reaches "72+ cities across 20 states", serving "marquee clients including Titan, Malabar Gold, and Senco Gold" and a network of "~190 retail partners", with a primary focus on bridal and occasion-wear.
- Deck claims the company "Command[s] approximately 1% share of India's organized wholesale gold jewellery market".
- Claimed differentiators: strong expertise in Antique Gold bridal jewellery (Jadau, Meena, Kundan, Polki), custom design and private-label solutions, and "Maintaining uniqueness and secrecy of designs" — specially commissioned designs are not used in its own showroom or provided to other retailers.
- Retail arm is a single flagship showroom in Ahmedabad under the brand "Harit Zaveri Jewellers", positioned on "transparency and ethical practices".
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [IR outsourced] Investor Relations representation is handled by Ernst & Young LLP (Kanav Khanna | Rhea Dharia) alongside the Company Secretary.
- [Internal contradiction] The Q1FY27 highlights slide states EBITDA of INR 180 Mn and EBITDA margin of 14.9% (and the trend chart labels 14.90%), while the quarterly income statement in the same deck shows EBITDA of INR 179 Mn and margin of 14.82%; revenue is likewise shown as INR 1,208 Mn, 1,209 Mn and "INR 1208 Mn" in different places.
- [Chart caption mismatch] On the share-price slide the title reads "Share Price Movement from 1st July 2025 to 30th July 2026" while the axis runs 01-Jul-25 to 01-Jun-26 and the price data is stated as of 30th June 2026.
business.title: Notable from the deck

latest_quarter.body: Gross margin: Retail ~12-14%, Wholesale ~7-8%, Job work ~6-8%; EBITDA margin improved to 11.19% (Q4) and 14.44% (FY26); cost advantage from in-house manufacturing and 20-25% inventory cushion vs market price
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: revenue growth: no formal guidance; margin: no guidance; order inflow: no guidance; capex/commissioning: Surat & Rajkot stores to open in Q2FY27; Gandhinagar & Maninagar mid-format stores planned; no new manufacturing capex planned
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: Expansion into 4 stores in Gujarat (Surat, Rajkot, Gandhinagar, Maninagar); potential future entry into other states post-Gujarat dominance; digital campaigns driving daily wear and occasion wear demand
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Revenue and profitability grew strongly on festive demand and retail expansion, with EBITDA margin expanding 63bps QoQ and PAT up 36% YoY; the shift toward higher-margin retail and job work, coupled with strategic store expansion in Gujarat, is redefining the growth trajectory beyond wholesale dependency.

meta.thesis: Revenue and profitability grew strongly on festive demand and retail expansion, with EBITDA margin expanding 63bps QoQ and PAT up 36% YoY; the shift toward higher-margin retail and job work, coupled with strategic store expansion in Gujarat, is redefining the growth trajectory beyond wholesale dependency.
